FR-001.title: Single tabbed screen replaces the numbered step sequence

FR-002.title: Each tab groups logically related settings; no 1-2-setting tabs

FR-003.title: Tabs are navigable both by direct click and by Next

FR-004.title: Next does not advance past an invalid tab

FR-005.title: Last tab is a read-only review of every entered value

FR-006.title: Review tab shows added roles and accounts as list boxes

FR-007.title: Finish validates all tabs' required fields before completing

FR-008.title: Committee roles added one at a time via a + control

FR-009.title: Added roles listed and removable before finishing

FR-010.title: Blank or duplicate role titles are rejected

FR-011.title: New Chart of Accounts tab lets the user queue entries via the shared add-account fields

FR-012.title: Queued accounts are not created until Finish; shown in the tab's queued list meanwhile

FR-013.title: Duplicate account names (queued or persisted) are rejected the same as the standalone page

FR-014.title: Adding an account is optional, never blocks finishing setup

FR-015.title: Add-account experience is shared: immediate-create on the standalone page, deferred on the wizard tab

FR-016.title: Theme is a dropdown selector, applies immediately

FR-017.title: Every other yes/no setting is a checkbox, not a toggle switch

FR-018.title: Regrouping into tabs preserves every field, rule, and default

FR-019.title: Sample-data checkbox still debug-build-only regardless of tab

context: constraint: reuse the Tabs/Tab BlazorBootstrap component already used by FinancePage.razor
constraint: RadzenDataGrid for tabular data per CLAUDE.md data-grid standards
constraint: no @code blocks — every .razor pairs with a .razor.cs
intent: Replace the setup wizard's linear five-step flow with a single tabbed screen, logically regrouped, that also lets coordinators add committee roles and Chart of Accounts entries inline and review everything before finishing.
expectations: Settings page's own General tab (post-setup theme toggle) is unchanged — only the /setup wizard is in scope
No change to what data first-run setup captures, validates, or defaults — only how it's grouped/entered
